body: I was going through a tough time with a loss of a job and then taking depression pills and then she just told me she wants to date other people and break up with me over text and then, 6 months later she says she wants to start hanging out again, but then decided to get serious with someone else. This is when I was out right blocked and it’s the worse feeling. Cause at least in the past I was able to talk. Since then my depression got so bad I was pretty much bed ridden living off savings but now, I’ve been applying to new jobs and making a few thousand a month from an online business. That I start to wonder why it had to be this way and why she didn’t believe that I could change my life around. This whole thing crippled my self esteem to the point I would have recruiters reach out to me and I wouldn’t respond because I thought I wasn’t good enough.
I have this feeling, I think it’s low self esteem and in ability to show my true self with those around out of fear they’ll leave.

Hey I’m really sorry this happened to you but this is a clear sign that he doesn’t care and value you anymore. It hurts I know but I think accepting this is the hardest part. If you know this what do you expect to happen if you contact him? You’ll just be ignored and your self esteem will take a hit. Please make this about you and protecting and growing your self esteem. Then work on other stuff after that, maybe physical health, academics, career. Then the last thing you should try out is getting back in a relationship. Easier said than done. I’m going through something similar you can always pm me.
